_README: Explicit book-to-repo mapping consumed by verify-book-vs-repo.py.
Only HAND-MAINTAINED correspondences live here. Anything the pipeline
generates (sql/chNN/*.sql from sqlBlock ids, sql/chNN/.expected/*.txt read
back by psqlBlock(expected(...))) is structurally drift-proof and is not
listed.
csharp  keyed by listing id (the listingCaption id that owns the codeBlock).
string       -> every part of that listing is a substring of this file
array        -> one repo path per printed part; length must equal the
block's `parts` count
null         -> documented teaching composite with no source file;
reported COMPOSITE, never a failure
A Ch21-23 codeBlock missing from this table is UNMAPPED (exit 2), so a
newly printed listing cannot silently escape the checker.
schema  repo file -> chapter number, for files whose name does not encode it.
schema/migrations/0NN-chMM-*.sql derives its chapter from the filename.
config  01-01 prints an ABRIDGED docker-compose.yml (ports deliberately altered,
disclosed in the caption), so only keyPatterns lines are compared, and
only book-subset-of-repo. composeVsConf cross-checks that every `-c
key=value` in the compose command has an uncommented `key = value` in
config/book-settings.conf.
Paths are POSIX-style and relative to CodeSample/.

csharpNotes.21-01: Teaching composite: one annotated connection string assembled from Ch17/Ch20 pieces. No compiling counterpart.
csharpNotes.21-17: ASCII directory tree of schema/ and schema/migrations/, not code.
csharpNotes.22-01: Printed in two codeBlocks so the page break lands cleanly; part 2 is the single closing brace of the Ticket class.
